question: Which is the programme launched by the Government of India in 2020, focusing on making India a self-sufficient country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atmanirbhar Bharat.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat** launched by the Government of India in 2020, focuses on making India a self-sufficient country.
 
• The Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyaan was launched by the Prime Minister **on 12th May 2020.**
 
• The idea is a catch-all for the Modi administration's aspirations for India to participate more actively in the** global economy and to improve its efficiency, competitiveness, and resilience.**
 
• The Mission emphasizes the need of supporting local goods. 
 
• Self-reliance implies creating a helping hand for the entire planet rather than advocating any isolationist or exclusive tactics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) Mission was launched on 25th June 2015.

 
 
• Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana's (Urban) aim is to provide housing for all in urban areas by the year 2022.
 
 
 
• The Stand Up India Scheme is aimed at promoting entrepreneurship among SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs and facilitates at least two such projects per bank branch. ** **
 
 
• It provides for refinancing through the** Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)** with an initial amount of Rs. 10,000 crore.
 
 
 
• Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY) was launched in 2014.
 
 
• Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi launched Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY) on 11th October 2014 on the birth anniversary of Lok Nayak Jai Prakash Narayan at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi.
